title: REQ · A 401 from Retry or Reject returns AdminApp to the token gate
summary: Retry and Reject 401 responses clear the token and show the gate with Invalid token
description: Context: AdminApp.runExecutionAction routes a 401 ApiError to handleError, which clears the token and sets gateError 'Invalid token'. Only the Approve 401 is tested today. Desired behavior: Retry and Reject 401 are proven to behave identically. Expected result: the token input is shown with an Invalid token alert. Why: an expired admin token must never leave stale controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given a FAILED execution, when Retry gets 401, then the gate shows an alert 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field
Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject gets 401, then the gate shows an alert 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field

in_scope: 401 handling for Retry and Reject in AdminApp
